name: Galicia
summary: A white field with a blue diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly. It comes from the flag of the port of A Coruña.
origin: The blue saltire on white was the maritime registration flag of A Coruña; when the saltire was reduced to one band it became associated with Galicia. The flag was adopted officially in 1984.
facts: The official version adds the arms with a chalice and crosses.
Santiago de Compostela is its capital.
clues: A single blue diagonal band on white.
It came from a port's maritime flag.
The region of Santiago de Compostela.
